name: Shibuya (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Shibuya ward emblem in white: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised character of angular strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Shibuya, a ward in Tokyo; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 1956.

features.role: Shibuya ward emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised character of angular strokes
